references.name: Professor Ali Abbas
references.reference: Professor Ali Abbas is a global expert in sustainability, waste reduction, and smart engineering systems. He leads research and partnerships as the Associate Dean at the University of Sydney and directs the Waste Transformation Research Hub.

references.name: Associate Professor Muhammed Yousufuddin
references.reference: As the former Director of the Center for Nanostructured Materials at the University of Texas at Arlington, Dr. Yousufuddin moved to UNT Dallas in 2015 to teach chemistry, advise pre-health students, and expand the biology and chemistry programs.
